meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: Claude 会把 HEAD 与最新已发布的 npm 版本做对比,按发布层列出全部未发布的改动,并说明每层该用 patch、minor 还是 major 升级,再给一个整体发布建议。它会直接输出分析,不反问。
howto.when: 当你想看未发布的改动、changelog,或问“有什么新变化”时触发。触发后立即输出分析,不做任何询问和开场白。

say.text: 看看 HEAD 和已发布的 npm 版本相比有哪些未发布改动
say.note: 立即按发布层列出全部未发布变更

say.text: 把未发布变更按发布层归类,别只抄提交信息
say.note: 它会读 diff 用白话描述真实改动

say.text: 给每个发布层推荐 patch、minor 还是 major
say.note: 输出分层版本建议加一个整体 bump

howto.what_en: Claude diffs HEAD against the latest published npm versions, lists every unpublished change grouped by release layer, and recommends a version bump per layer plus one overall bump. It outputs the analysis immediately, with no questions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about unpublished changes, a changelog, what changed, or what's new. It then outputs the analysis immediately, with no questions or preamble.

say_en.text: Show me what's unpublished compared to the latest npm versions
say_en.note: Lists every unpublished change by layer

say_en.text: Group the unpublished changes by release layer, don't just copy commits
say_en.note: Reads the diff and describes the real change

say_en.text: Recommend patch, minor or major for each release layer
say_en.note: Gives per-layer bumps plus one overall bump
